'''Grand Lord''', also known as '''Grand High Lord''', was the title of the ruler of the [[Circle of Lords]], the ruling council of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]].<ref name="Ascension" /> It could be considered roughly equivalent to the Jedi ranks of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] and [[Master of the Order/Legends|Master of the Order]]. Ranking below the Grand Lord were the seven [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lords]] and the thirteen [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords]]. Grand Lords would hold audience with their High Lords in their [[Grand Lord's Throne Room|throne room]]. The first Grand Lord was [[Yaru Korsin]], who was appointed to the position in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] by the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Izri Dazh]]. As of [[44 ABY]] the Grand Lord was [[Darish Vol]].
